mapper.select: select p.*, m.name from tbl_expert_profile p inner join tbl_member m on m.member_seq = p.expert_seq where p.expert_seq = #{expertSeq}
select r.region_name from tbl_expert_region er inner join tbl_region r on r.region_seq = er.region_seq where er.expert_seq = #{expertSeq} order by r.region_seq

select p.expert_seq, m.name, count(r.review_seq) as review_count, round(avg(r.rating), 1) as average_rating from tbl_expert_profile p inner join tbl_member m on m.member_seq = p.expert_seq left join tbl_review r on r.expert_seq = p.expert_seq where p.hidden = 'N' and m.enabled = 'Y' group by p.expert_seq, m.name order by average_rating desc nulls last, review_count desc fetch first 4 rows only
